caption: The video captures a flat, tan-colored piece of material resting on sandy ground, its center and left side already blackened and charred while the right portion remains unburnt. Open yellow-orange flames burn continuously along the left edge and along a folded right edge, the combustion already underway and remaining underway throughout. The two flame tongues flicker and change height, the left one alternating between short upright licks and long horizontal streaks stretched toward the upper left, while the right one shifts between tall vertical forms and shorter curved shapes. Small isolated orange-red embers appear intermittently to the left of and above the burning piece, vanishing in neighboring moments. The charred and unburnt regions hold roughly the same outline and position on the ground, with no visible translation or large deformation of the piece itself. Surrounding sand, scattered pebbles, dark burnt fragments, and a grey ash pile at the right edge stay fixed, indicating a stationary camera. The fire continues burning through the final visible moment, with no ignition or extinguishing captured within this span.
relations: Tan piece on sand, charred center and left, unburnt right, with flames persisting along left and folded right edges.
Flame tongues flicker, left stretching horizontally upper-left, right shifting tall to short, while piece outline stays fixed.
Small orange-red embers appear intermittently left and above the burning piece, then vanish in neighboring moments.
Surrounding sand, pebbles, burnt fragments, and right ash pile remain stationary, indicating a fixed camera.
